title: IRGC Navy Releases Unseen Footage of Crackdown on Violating Vessels in the Strait of Hormuz
text:
IRGC Navy Releases Unseen Footage of Crackdown on Violating Vessels in the Strait of Hormuz"

""
"The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) Navy has demonstrated decisive action and firm command in the Strait of Hormuz, declaring that any suspicious activity will be promptly targeted. In a first-of-its-kind release, unpublished images of the surveillance and operations against offending vessels have been made public. Furthermore, the IRGC asserted that the United States remains the single greatest threat to the security of regional countries and maritime trade, describing Washington's claims of providing support and escort as a "great lie.
